summary: "The Family at Misrule" by Ethel Turner is a children's novel published in 1895. This sequel to "Seven Little Australians" returns to the beloved family five years later, when young Bunty flees after being accused of theft. While his family believes he's sailed to America, he remains hidden in Sydney. His sister Nellie faces her own trials after attending a dinner party with dangerous consequences.
